name: DishNet MikroTik Control Plane
summary: Router registry, provisioning, HotSpot policy, vouchers, sessions and AAA publication for MikroTik estates.

notes: Domain A (Starlink/UCRM) is NOT a dependency. This plugin owns its own PostgreSQL schema and never reads or writes Domain A state.
The Admin Panel is a SEPARATE consumer and is not part of this package. It reaches the plugin only over the HTTP API declared below.

requires.postgresql_role: the plugin does not create its database. plugin/bin/bootstrap.sql creates an owner role with CREATEROLE and CREATEDB (not superuser, not BYPASSRLS) and an empty database owned by it.
requires.worker: bin/worker.php is a long-running process for the intent queue. The Admin read panel does not need it; provisioning does. Not bound.
requires.web_server: any server that serves panel/ as static files and routes /api/v1/admin/* to plugin/public/api.php. The API reads the raw REQUEST_URI path, so a prefix mount must be stripped before PHP sees it.

DNB_DSN.description: PDO DSN for the plugin's own PostgreSQL database.

DNB_TOKEN_PEPPER.description: HMAC pepper for auth tokens and activation tickets.

DNB_ADMINAPI_USER.description: Admin read role. Defaults to dnb_adminapi.

DN_ALLOW_REAL_BINDINGS.description: F6-B gate. Absent or not 'yes-f6b-authorized' means every hardware adapter stays simulated.

DNB_SECRET_KEY.description: Symmetric key for stored device credentials. SecretBox refuses to run without it, so every device-credential path fails closed while it is unset. The Admin read panel does not use it.

DNB_OWNER_USER.description: Schema owner. Install-time only; never serves a request. Defaults to the migration role name.

DNB_OWNER_PASS.description: Schema owner. Install-time only; never serves a request. Provisioned at install time (docs/97). The migrations create this role with no password at all, and Database::connect() has no default, so an unset value raises rather than attempting an empty string.

DNB_APP_USER.description: Operator-plane request role (the Customer PWA API). Defaults to the migration role name.

DNB_APP_PASS.description: Operator-plane request role (the Customer PWA API). Provisioned at install time (docs/97). The migrations create this role with no password at all, and Database::connect() has no default, so an unset value raises rather than attempting an empty string.

DNB_WORKER_USER.description: Intent worker role. Defaults to the migration role name.

DNB_WORKER_PASS.description: Intent worker role. Provisioned at install time (docs/97). The migrations create this role with no password at all, and Database::connect() has no default, so an unset value raises rather than attempting an empty string.

DNB_ADMIN_USER.description: Legacy Admin role; carries migration 015 blanket grants. Defaults to the migration role name.

DNB_ADMIN_PASS.description: Legacy Admin role; carries migration 015 blanket grants. Provisioned at install time (docs/97). The migrations create this role with no password at all, and Database::connect() has no default, so an unset value raises rather than attempting an empty string.

DNB_ADMINWRITE_USER.description: Admin write role: EXECUTE on seven functions, zero table privileges. Defaults to the migration role name.

DNB_ADMINWRITE_PASS.description: Admin write role: EXECUTE on seven functions, zero table privileges. Provisioned at install time (docs/97). The migrations create this role with no password at all, and Database::connect() has no default, so an unset value raises rather than attempting an empty string.

DNB_RADIUS_USER.description: RADIUS accounting ingestion role. Defaults to the migration role name.

DNB_RADIUS_PASS.description: RADIUS accounting ingestion role. Provisioned at install time (docs/97). The migrations create this role with no password at all, and Database::connect() has no default, so an unset value raises rather than attempting an empty string.

DNB_STAFFAUTH_USER.description: DishNet staff AUTHENTICATION role (migration 026): EXECUTE on mt_staff_login, mt_staff_session_resolve and mt_staff_logout, zero table privileges. Defaults to the migration role name.

DNB_STAFFAUTH_PASS.description: DishNet staff authentication role password. Provisioned at install time (docs/97). The migrations create this role with no password at all, and Database::connect() has no default, so an unset value raises rather than attempting an empty string.

DNB_INTERNAL_TOKEN.description: Shared secret for the internal RADIUS accounting route. Unset means that route admits nobody.

DNB_EXPOSE_OTP.description: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Returns the OTP in API responses. plugin.php doctor treats this as a blocker outside a disposable environment.

DN_DEV_STAFF_IDENTITY.description: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Binds the Admin panel to a fabricated staff identity. Staff authentication (W-4) is not built, so this is currently the only way the panel renders anything.

DN_STAFF_IDENTITY.description: Selects the DishNet staff identity provider. Unset: DenyAllIdentity, nobody can sign in. 'dishnet': the real provider of migration 026 (bcrypt + TOTP verified in PostgreSQL, revocable server-side sessions). Any other value refuses to start. Refuses to coexist with DN_DEV_STAFF_IDENTITY.

DN_STAFF_REQUIRE_TOTP.description: Whether a DishNet staff session needs a confirmed authenticator before it can do anything but enrol one. Unset or 'yes' (the default): required. 'no': password-only sessions are complete — development only; plugin.php doctor treats it as a blocker outside a disposable environment (D-AUTH-5: mandatory before a public hostname).

DN_PORTAL_ORIGIN.description: The DishNet Portal's origin, e.g. https://admin.example. A mutating request whose Origin header names anything else is refused (403 cross_origin). Unset: the Origin must match the request's own Host.

DN_TRUSTED_PROXY.description: Comma-separated addresses of the reverse proxy that terminates TLS. X-Forwarded-Proto is believed only from these; from anyone else it is ignored. Unset: only a request PHP itself received over TLS counts as TLS, and the real provider refuses to issue a session over anything else (403 insecure_transport).

DNB_INSPECT_USER.description: TESTS ONLY. A BYPASSRLS fixture identity. Setting it in a deployment puts a row-level-security bypass into the runtime environment.

DNB_SECRETS_OUT.description: Install-time only. File the installer writes GENERATED secrets to, created 0600 before anything is written. Required when any secret has to be generated; unused when every password is supplied.

DNB_ROTATE_CREDENTIALS.description: Install-time only. Set to yes-rotate-now to mint new passwords for roles that predate this installation. Refused by default because the roles are cluster-wide and may belong to another database.

writes.reason: These paths EXIST and every one answers 501. They are declared so the capability matrix is complete and testable, not because anything is bound. The seven estate writes wait for G-C / G-C2. The eighth, principal creation for an explicit target operator, has its function since migration 027 (mt_admin_principal_create, dnb_adminwrite, docs/116 D.9) and its route binding is a separate instruction (docs/116 §J J-1).

session.note: The login boundary. NOT capability-gated -- a capability is what authenticating grants, so gating login on one would be a lock whose key is behind the lock. Since migration 026 these routes DO write identity state (a revocable session row, an audit row) through definer functions owned by dnb_def_staff; they write no estate table, which is why 'writes.bound' stays empty.
session.production: POST answers 501 production_authentication_unavailable unless a staff identity provider is configured. The default is DenyAllIdentity (the W-4 posture) and there is no fallback from it to the development identity. DN_STAFF_IDENTITY=dishnet binds the real provider of migration 026, which closes W-4 in development; whether a deployment binds it is that deployment's explicit choice.

providers.deny-all: the default. Nobody can sign in; every estate route is 401 and POST /session is 501.
providers.DEVELOPMENT-ONLY: DN_DEV_STAFF_IDENTITY=yes-development-only. No credential; a role picker. Refuses to construct alongside real bindings (F6-B) or alongside the real provider.
providers.dishnet: DN_STAFF_IDENTITY=dishnet. Migration 026: bcrypt (pgcrypto, cost 12) and RFC 6238 TOTP verified inside mt_staff_login() with a decaying lockout (5 failures -> 15 min, doubling, 24 h ceiling, never permanent); an opaque 256-bit cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict) stored only as an HMAC under a label-derived key; 8 h absolute, server-side, revocable sessions; a session is issued only over TLS.

staff.note: The DishNet staff roster (migration 026, docs/114 D-AUTH-7). Admin only. Every act is one SECURITY DEFINER function owned by dnb_def_staff, EXECUTE-able by dnb_adminwrite, that writes its own audit row (actor_kind='staff', actor = the authenticated username) in the same transaction. Bound only when the real provider is. The generated password is returned once and stored nowhere. No route here reads or writes an estate table.

operator_plane.note: The /api/v1/me surface (public/index.php, not this entry point) is capability-guarded since migration 027 (docs/116 §E): kind and capabilities are re-read live from mt_auth_resolve_token() on every request, every /me route declares an op.* capability, and the six commercial functions refuse with SQLSTATE 42501 beneath the guard. Five staff-management routes (/me/staff) exist, all op.staff.manage, which only an owner can hold.
operator_plane.capabilities_source: mt_op_capabilities() — the single canonical list; Dn\Auth\OpCapability::ALL is asserted equal by the suite.

install.prerequisite: psql -U <superuser> -d postgres -v db=dnb -v owner=dnb -v owner_pass=<generated> -f plugin/bin/bootstrap.sql
creates: postgresql schema (tables, policies, functions); pgcrypto, the schema's first extension (migration 026)
role credentials, supplied or generated — never in the repository
install.credentials: supplied via DNB_*_PASS, or generated into DNB_SECRETS_OUT at mode 0600. No credential exists in the repository or the package.
install.first_administrator: php plugin/bin/plugin.php staff:bootstrap <username> --display "Full Name" — refuses once any staff row exists; prints the generated password once.

removes: every mt_* table and function in the public schema
does_not_remove: the owner role created by bootstrap.sql

F6-B.meaning: Real MikroTik and real FreeRADIUS bindings. While closed, every hardware adapter is a simulator and says so.

admin-write.meaning: No state-changing ESTATE route exists: every declared estate write answers 501. The identity routes (session, staff roster) are bound since migration 026 and change identity state only.

portal.meaning: Guest voucher activation. Blocked on Decision 5 (gated) and the F-7 remediation design.

staff-identity.meaning: Migration 026 and DishnetStaffIdentity exist. DenyAllIdentity remains the default binding; DN_STAFF_IDENTITY=dishnet selects the real provider explicitly. Production authentication also needs TLS in front of PHP (DN_TRUSTED_PROXY) and a first administrator from staff:bootstrap.

excludes: public/ (the Customer PWA API front controller, which nothing here serves)
